How 1994 San Marino Grand Prix connects

  • Character: Ayrton Senna — Ayrton Senna was killed at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix.
  • Location: Imola — The 1994 San Marino Grand Prix was run at Imola.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — Senna's death at Imola forced Formula 1's modern safety revolution.

What is 1994 San Marino Grand Prix?

The 1994 San Marino Grand Prix at Imola killed Roland Ratzenberger and Ayrton Senna. The FIA's later safety revolution — circuits, cockpits, the halo's ancestors — dates from that weekend.
